q1.sampleAnswer: The author is not sure if his/her earliest memory is real.

keyPoints.descZh: 作者不确定自己最早的记忆是不是真的
examples: not sure if his earliest memory is real

q1.rubricZh: 要点：作者不确定最早的记忆是否真实。
q1.explanationZh: 第二段 There’s just one problem 后面的冒号就是在解释这个问题：他不确定那段记忆是不是真的。

evidence.quote: I’m not sure if it’s real.

q2.sampleAnswer: Around four out of every ten people.

keyPoints.descZh: 大约十分之四（四成）的人
examples: around four out of every ten

q2.rubricZh: 要点：大约每十人中有四人（40%）。
q2.explanationZh: 第三段第一句直接给出数字：大约每十个人里有四个编造了自己的第一段记忆。

evidence.quote: around four out of every ten of us have made up our first memory

q3.sampleAnswer: Because our brains are unable to store long-term memories before we reach the age of two.

keyPoints.descZh: 因为两岁前大脑无法储存长期记忆
examples: brains are unable to store long-term memories before two

q3.rubricZh: 要点：两岁前大脑无法储存长期记忆。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说，两岁之前我们的大脑存不住长期记忆，所以想不起那时的事。

evidence.quote: Our brains are unable to store long-term memories before we reach the age of two.

q4.sampleAnswer: It’s possible to create false memories in people.

keyPoints.descZh: 可以让人产生虚假的记忆
examples: it is possible to create false memories in people

q4.rubricZh: 要点：可以在人的脑子里制造虚假记忆。
q4.explanationZh: 第五段先说研究表明能制造假记忆，Julia Shaw 让七成的人相信自己犯过罪，就是这个例子，所以实验说明假记忆是可以被制造出来的。

evidence.quote: Research has shown that it’s possible to create false memories in people.

q5.sampleAnswer: 180 volunteers were told they got ill from eating egg sandwiches as kids; many believed it and avoided egg sandwiches for a long time.

keyPoints.descZh: 180 名志愿者被告知小时候吃鸡蛋三明治生过病，很多人信了并开始避开它
examples: 180 volunteers were told they had become ill from eating egg sandwiches
many began to avoid egg sandwiches

q5.rubricZh: 要点：180 名志愿者被告知小时候吃蛋三明治生病，许多人信以为真，并因此避开蛋三明治。
q5.explanationZh: 最后一段举的例子：志愿者被告知小时候吃蛋三明治生过病，不少人信了，之后就不吃了，有的人四个月后还不吃。

evidence.quote: In one study, 180 volunteers were told that they had become ill from eating egg sandwiches as children.

q6.sampleAnswer: No, I don’t. We cannot change what happened in the past. I believe that it’s more important for us to focus on the present and the future. (Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 明确表明态度（想要或不想要完整的自我叙述）

examples: We cannot change what happened in the past.
It is more important to focus on the present and the future.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题：表明态度（Yes/No）并给出合理理由即可。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题：先说出你的态度，再用一两句话讲理由，理由通顺合理就可以。

evidence.quote: we desire a complete narrative of our own existence
